CONCRETE FEATS — FORCE AND SURVIVAL
- Massacre at Ossus (130 ABY): As a Padawan, Cade held his own against a large number of stormtroopers and Sith despite still being a child in training. [4]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 1 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 4; approximate match 0.76, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- He used Dark transfer, described as an instinctive power, to revive Wolf Sazen from death. The article says Sazen was soon able to talk and walk independently. [4]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 1 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 4; per-sentence approximate match (2/2 sentences matched, min 0.83), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- After the Vendaxa fight, Cade healed Princess Marasiah Fel with the same lightning technique used to heal Wolf. [17]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- On Coruscant, he sensed Hosk Trey'lis inside the Temple of the Sith from outside the structure; he overpowered Darth Talon before Darth Nihl choked him into submission. [11]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 14 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 11; per-sentence approximate match (2/2 sentences matched, min 0.60), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- During the Sith escape, he defeated Darth Talon and Darth Nihl, then refused Krayt's order to kill Nihl. He used his father's lightsaber after shattering its transparisteel case with the Force. [21][22]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 19 ; Legacy (2006) 31 ; Legacy (2006) 18 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 22,47,21; per-sentence approximate match (2/2 sentences matched, min 0.64), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- The article says he used Force lightning to injure Hand-class Sith Darth Nihl and defeat an elite Sith Trooper; this sentence has no numbered citation displayed in the section.
  Source: Legacy (2006) 38 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 45; approximate match 0.72, verify]
- He projected a protection bubble over himself and Deliah Blue against the Wayland base explosion and its residual effects. [32]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 46 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 32; approximate match 0.85, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- After Krayt's return, Cade leapt after Vul Isen, cut him in half in mid-air, and caught the virus container, saving Utapau. [37]
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; approximate match 0.68, verify)

HEALING / DARK TRANSFER
- The article calls Dark transfer Cade's “most impressive and mysterious power.” It says he revived Wolf by drawing on the dark side; Force lightning coursed over both bodies and Cade's eyes glowed with Force energy. [4]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 1 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 4; exact text match; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- Cade later said the price of reviving Sazen was tapping into “all the fear and rage” in himself; he also feared the hunger for power felt that day was “not a good place for a Skywalker to be.” [3][15]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 5 ; Legacy (2006) 3 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 15,3; exact text match; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- Wolf Sazen told him: “Healing me like you did was not something you were taught—you did that by instinct alone.” [16] This is a character statement about the feat.
  Source: Legacy (2006) 6 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 16; exact text match; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- The article says Cade could purge ailments from other bodies, heal or injure by focusing on a wound/shatterpoint, and manipulate a person's body through the ability. [5][2]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- During the Sith period, Cade healed Darth Talon after reopening her recently healed wounds; the article says their bond was created when he healed her. [5][20]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- Cade used the power to cure himself and Azlyn Rae of the Rakghoul plague, impressing Celeste Morne and Karness Muur. [27]
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; approximate match 0.74, verify)
- He could not initially heal Deliah Blue from Maladi's weapon using dark-side healing. After Wolf told him to use the light side, Cade used the light side and his love for Blue; the weapon died and Blue was freed. [32]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- After Celeste Morne badly wounded Azlyn, Cade repeatedly used his healing powers to keep her alive, but could not completely heal injuries that severe. [27][28]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- On the Wheel, Cade initially said he could not heal his dying mother because he had only healed Blue with the light side and that it worked because he loved her. After Kol urged him to forgive her, Cade successfully healed Morrigan Corde with the light side. [39]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- The article says repeated healing of Azlyn pushed Cade toward the dark side; he ultimately collapsed from exhaustion. [28]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

VERSUS DARTH KRAYT — EVENTS
- Krayt sensed the dark-side use when Cade revived Wolf from the New Imperial Palace on Coruscant and searched for him, calling him a “dark light in the Force.” [4]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 1 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 4; exact text match; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- After capturing Cade, Krayt tried to recruit him; Cade refused. Cade then cured Syn and Blue's implanted Yorik-Kul coral seeds at great cost. [6]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 15 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 6; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.77), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- Krayt ordered Cade to heal Talon and later fought him in the Temple of the Sith. Cade held Krayt off in a lightsaber duel until Morrigan Corde's intervention enabled his escape. [5][22]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 16 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 5; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.68), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- On Had Abbadon, Cade defeated Talon again and quickly defeated Darth Stryfe (with help from Syn's explosives). Krayt was blasted by Muur's Force lightning and survived being Force-pushed off a cliff. [27]
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; approximate match 0.74, verify)
- After learning Krayt had returned from the dead, Cade's vision framed his destiny as stopping Krayt. The article reports that Cade later fought Krayt at the Battle of Coruscant, was injured to the point of death, returned from death, and killed Krayt after declaring himself a Jedi. [37][2]
  Source: Legacy — War 6 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 2; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.63), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- Cade expected Krayt to revive again, so he took Krayt's body toward Coruscant's sun. Krayt's spirit claimed it would use Cade as a host, but Cade rejected this; Luke's guidance let Cade escape and enter a Jedi healing trance. [2]

ARTICLE-STATED SCALING / POWER CLAIMS (NOT INDEPENDENT FEATS)
- The Powers and abilities section says Cade had a naturally strong connection to the Force and was “immensely powerful in its use.”
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; exact text match)
- Krayt's recruitment statement: “You have power, Skywalker. Join me, and I will teach you to use that power!” [6]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 15 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 6; exact text match; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- The Biography says Krayt acknowledged Cade had “more power than he had ever seen in any Jedi.” This is Krayt's assessment, not a neutral measurement. [6]
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; exact text match)
- The article says Cade's use of the Force was powerful enough to control lightning and prevent his ship being torn apart by a planet-wide lightning storm. [4][46]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 1 ; Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 4,46; article sentence itself uncited (lead/summary); citation taken from the closest cited body passage, approximate match 0.81, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- The article says Cade's Force scream impressed Krayt. That is a reaction/character opinion, not a quantified feat. [6]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 15 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 6; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.80), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- Krayt's lightsaber assessment: “The only thing that saves you thus far, is the blood of Vader that runs through your veins.” [22] This is dialogue/hype, not a demonstrated feat.
  Source: Legacy (2006) 19 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 22; exact text match; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- The article says Cade held his own against Krayt in their Temple duel, later held Krayt off until escape, and ultimately killed him after returning from death. [22][2]
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- Explicit comparison: the article says Cade was able to equal Antares Draco, leader of the Imperial Knights, in lightsaber ability. [25]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 25 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 25; approximate match 0.64, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- The article says Cade defeated Talon and Stryfe on Had Abbadon, killed Vul Isen, and later defeated Sith forces before killing Krayt. [47][37][40][2]
  Source: Legacy (2006) 31 ; Legacy (2006) 48 ; Legacy (2006) 50 [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 47,36,37; approximate match 0.67, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- The article's “Ultimately” statement says Cade found the ability Anakin Skywalker had long desired: keeping loved ones from dying. This is an article claim about thematic/power significance, not proof that Cade exceeded Anakin overall. [46]
  Source: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith [per Wookieepedia "Cade Skywalker" rev 15549841, ref 46; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.70), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
